benefits_health_001.answer: Yes. Eligible group: teachers and their dependents. Plans: The Advantage Non-HMO and The Advantage HMO.
benefits_health_001.evidence: The Board shall make available to teachers and their dependents hospitalization, surgical, major medical and emergency family insurance. Employees may select coverage from these two programs: (1) The Advantage Non-HMO. (2) The Advantage HMO.

benefits_health_contribution_002.answer: Board provides annual maximum contributions: Employee $4,933.00; Employee/Child $6,727.00; Employee/Spouse $9,034.00; Family $9,658.00.
benefits_health_contribution_002.evidence: Beginning January 1, 2009, for each employee electing coverage for himself/herself or including his/her dependents, the Board shall make the following annual maximum contribution for such coverage, and the employee shall pay any additional premiums: Employee $4,933.00; Employee/Child $6,727.00; Employee/Spouse $9,034.00; Family $9,658.00

benefits_health_employee_premium_003.answer: Pay any additional premiums beyond the Board's maximum contribution.
benefits_health_employee_premium_003.evidence: the Board shall make the following annual maximum contribution for such coverage, and the employee shall pay any additional premiums

benefits_dependent_health_004.answer: Yes. Coverage options for Employee and Child or Children, Employee and Spouse, and Employee and Family (Spouse and Children).
benefits_dependent_health_004.evidence: Coverage shall be available on the basis of four (4) options: 1. Employee 2. Employee and Child or Children 3. Employee and Spouse 4. Employee and Family (Spouse and Children)

benefits_health_plan_type_005.evidence: Employees may select coverage from these two programs: (1) The Advantage Non-HMO. (2) The Advantage HMO.

benefits_dental_006.answer: Yes. Available to teachers and their dependents. Employer pays annual premium except $0.26, which is paid by the teacher.
benefits_dental_006.evidence: Each teacher and his/her dependents shall be covered by a dental insurance plan. The Board shall pay the annual premium with the exception of twenty-six cents ($.26) which shall be paid by the teacher.
